transcript: I made topokie from my wife and she said first I chopped green onion into finger length pieces. I added olive oil and cooked green onion until they softened. Next, I added water, sugar, kuchkaru, soy sauce, and kuchuzang. Once it boiled, I added the rice cakes and let them simmer over medium heat. I stirred them around occasionally so they wouldn't stick to the pan. When the sauce thickened, I added a pinch of curry powder and boiled eggs so that my wife doesn't forget her protein.
